control.title: Physical access control
control.description: Protect offices and secure areas with perimeter controls, badge or biometric entry, visitor logs and monitoring. For cloud-hosted systems, rely on the provider's attestations.

evidence_hint: Office access system records, visitor log, cloud provider SOC 2 / ISO certificate.
acceptance_criteria: Office access controls (badge system records or visitor log) from the review period
For cloud-hosted systems, the provider's current ISO 27001 or SOC 2 report was reviewed

criteria_coverage.criterion: Office access controls (badge system records or visitor log) from the review period
For cloud-hosted systems, the provider's current ISO 27001 or SOC 2 report was reviewed
